questions.prompt: Write a report for a university lecturer describing the information in the graph below. Write at least 150 words.

Some people think it is a good thing for senior management positions to have very high salaries compared to other workers of the same company or organisation. To what extent do you agree? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
